#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n, b;
    std::cin >> n >> b;
    std::vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> arr[i];
    }

    int totalCount = 0, totalSum = 0, oddCount = 0, evenCount = 0;
    std::vector<int> diffList;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (arr[i] % 2 != 0) {
            oddCount++;
        } else {
            evenCount++;
        }
        if (i != n - 1 && oddCount == evenCount) {
            diffList.push_back(std::abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[i]));
        }
    }

    std::sort(diffList.begin(), diffList.end());

    for (int diff : diffList) {
        totalSum += diff;
        if (totalSum <= b) {
            totalCount++;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }

    std::cout << totalCount << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
